transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:

That's good to hear. I'm glad it's going okay overall.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Good, no redness. That's a positive sign.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's great to hear.

transcript.text:

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Okay, so it started shortly after the surgery.

transcript.speaker: agent

transcript.text:

transcript.text:
